reason: Free listing is fine, I'd let them load my flyers, but I'm not paying anything for a startup that may be gone in six months. My margins are thin and a new monthly fee gets cut unless it clearly brings people in.
objection: You're a startup, will you still be around in six months? 500 people on a waitlist is not an audience, and I won't pay until I see real crowds coming through the door because of the app.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app pass 2,000 monthly users in my city, and proof from another venue that it filled their nights, so the fee clearly pays for itself.
